runs.name: Rantizo, formerly SKK Holdings Limited; Nasdaq RNTZ since 2026-10-13, formerly SKK, SEC CIK 0001991261, Cayman Islands, Form 20-F, fiscal year to December 31, reporting in US dollars with a Singapore-dollar functional currency; Singapore subsurface-utility civil engineering contractor (SKK Works and SKK M&E, all public-sector work) which on 2026-10-09 bought substantially all of Rantizo, Inc.'s drone-based agricultural spraying, seeding and monitoring technology assets for 51,966,591 new Class A shares ($258.83M) and renamed itself Rantizo
runs.box: OUT AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$4.53** (RNTZ close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged; 8,200 shares that day). Shares **60,336,487** Class A, one class, built from the filings (the tools printed a stale 18,750,000); market value **$273.3M**; a $10M PIPE and a $10M capital raise due by 2026-10-16 under the Waiver Agreement not reported by the price date and not counted. Sovereign **2.41%** (SGD, SGS 30-year benchmark, Monetary Authority of Singapore, 2026-10-16; the protocol's table has no SGD row). Read from the 20-F FY2025 (0001493152-26-016229, filed 2026-04-10) and FY2024, the F-1, the F-3 and F-3/A, three 424B5s, the 2026 6-Ks and exhibits including the APA (6-K 2026-05-05, 0001493152-26-021165), the pro forma (6-K 2026-09-25, 0001493152-26-044299) and the closing report (6-K 2026-10-13, 0001493152-26-046697), the S-8s and Forms 3 and 4. `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` stale for this 20-F filer; arithmetic by hand in `compute.py`. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst (four, listed in the run file). The 20-F and the drone filings name no rival; none read. **Q1 OUT** **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**: the business the price pays for is a drone-technology start-up; the seller described itself at signing as "developing drone-based technology"; no financial statements of the seller or of the acquired assets in any filing; the pro forma adds no revenue for them; the filer's preliminary allocation of the $259.6M consideration is $0.38M equipment, $6.5M intangible, $252.7M goodwill (97%); customer contracts not on the APA's Schedule 1.1(a) excluded and the schedule not filed. The parts threshold has no input for a part with no filed record: the analyst sized it by purchase price as a CONVENTION of the run; under the literal threshold the legacy contractor decides and closes OUT at Q2 (tender work against 932 CW02-registered contractors, "keen competition and significant downward pricing pressure", most contracts without price adjustment, top five customers 96.0% of FY2025 revenue), so the box is OUT on either reading. After the stop, facts recorded, not judged: the CEO's spouse (71.2% of votes) and the COO sold their Class B shares to the seller at about $7.37 against the $4.98 issue price, the $8M deferred by the Waiver while their Forms 4 report it paid; 1,284,960 Management Shares to the CEO; 5,625,000 shares to "Professional Service Providers" in March 2026; a reverse split after a Nasdaq notice; an offering paid in Tether; 6,000,000 more shares registered on 2026-10-16; the seller about 88% of the shares with no Form 3 or Schedule 13D by the price date; a $4.9M FY2022 dividend to the controlling holders unpaid and in a $7.0M related-party payable; property and equipment tripled to $19.8M while revenue grew 2.1% a year; receivables and contract assets 71% of revenue; a material weakness, a new auditor, an FY2024 revision, FY2023 and FY2024 revenue changed between the two 20-Fs without explanation. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash of the contractor after every real cost $M FY2021 to FY2025: 2.47, 0.15, (2.73), (4.66), (8.29), average (2.61); depreciation in place of capex (0.03), before interest +0.20; the drone assets credited at nil (no filed earnings); **value range nil to nil a share** (about one cent with cash raised after year-end, before about $7.7M of deal costs), best case $8.3M at 2.41% less net debt $10.5M; no case earns the floor (best case 0.07% of a $283.8M enterprise value); **fair $0.00 all-equity, $0.00 equity-only**, not armed (box not OUT at Q7 or IN). Balance sheets FY2021 to FY2025 only (five, short of eight to ten). Contamination declared by the analyst: the git status snapshot (SNIRF commit subjects, AYI and ARCB folder names) and a memory index line; none used. Commits 2c482f5c (template), bd0b0b2c (Q1), f1056ae7 (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_run.py` 0 problems, 35 citations of 29 ids; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_adjacent.py`, 22 fragments beside an id, none outside its row (the paragraph-level `dispatcher_check.py` flagged 13 fragments, every one a filing quotation sharing a paragraph with an id, read and cleared); no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB (filings in the ignored cache). check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework notes): the parts threshold has no input for a part bought after the five-year window; Q1's start-up OUT against its fast-moving-technology TOO HARD when a technology start-up is both; no SGD row in the sovereign table. Could not get: the APA schedules, the Newbridge valuation report, any statements of the drone business, confirmation of the PIPE and the capital raise.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1 (Rantizo, formerly SKK Holdings, Nasdaq RNTZ formerly SKK; Singapore subsurface-utility contractor that on 2026-10-09 bought Rantizo, Inc.'s drone technology assets for 51,966,591 new shares ($258.83M) and took its name; the price now pays for a drone start-up with no filed revenue or statements, 97% of the consideration goodwill on the filer's own allocation; on the literal parts threshold the legacy tender contractor decides and closes OUT at Q2, so OUT on either reading. Facts recorded, not judged: insiders sold control to the seller at about $7.37 against the $4.98 issue price, payment deferred while their Forms 4 report it paid; management and adviser share grants; heavy issuance through 2026; an unpaid FY2022 dividend to the controlling holders; a material weakness and revised revenue. Computation beneath the stop: value range nil to nil, fair $0.00 all-equity and equity-only, not armed. No citation slip. Framework gaps for the operator: the parts threshold for a part with no filed record, Q1's start-up OUT against fast-moving technology TOO HARD, no SGD sovereign row.)
